extracted.name: Cricket Protein Powder Mac n Cheese
extracted.description: A rich and creamy macaroni and cheese that incorporates cricket protein powder right into the savory cheese sauce, creating a delicious lunch or dinner option that is both high in protein and eco-friendly.
instruction_lines: Prep: preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Shred cheeses, reserving 4 oz of cheddar for the top.
Pasta: boil 1/2 lb pasta until al dente, then drain and cool.
Sauce: melt butter, stir in flour, spices, and protein powder. Gradually stir in milk, salt, and pepper, cooking for 5 minutes before removing from heat.
Egg & Cheese: temper the egg by whisking it into 1/2 cup of cooled sauce, then stir back into the pot over medium-low heat. Melt the cheeses and stir in the pasta.
Bake: pour into a smaller, 8x8 or 9x9-inch dish, top with reserved cheese, and bake for 30 minutes
